title: Israeli military recovers the bodies of six hostages from a tunnel in Rafah
body:
On 1 September 2024, the Israeli military announced that it had recovered the bodies of six hostages from a tunnel beneath Rafah in southern Gaza. The six were Hersh Goldberg-Polin, 23, an Israeli-American; Eden Yerushalmi, 24; Ori Danino, 25; Alex Lubnov, 32; Carmel Gat, 40; and Almog Sarusi, 27. Five of them had been taken from the Nova music festival on 7 October 2023, and Gat from Kibbutz Be'eri.

IDF spokesperson Daniel Hagari said the six were brutally murdered by Hamas shortly before troops reached them, possibly only a day or two earlier. The IDF reported no clashes with Hamas inside the tunnel and said the guards likely responsible had fled, while troops fought militants above ground in the area. The recovery site was less than a mile from where Israeli forces had rescued Farhan al-Qadi a few days earlier.

United States President Joe Biden said he was devastated and outraged by the killing of Goldberg-Polin, vowed that Hamas leaders would pay for their crimes, and pledged to keep working for a deal to free the remaining hostages. The discovery prompted large demonstrations in Israel in the following days.
